g.text: Kallisto and Salmon share 3,262 differentially expressed genes

g.text: Six complete paired libraries; breed / wild. Same transcript reference, gene aggregation and R DESeq2 model.

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif

g.text: One shared DE gene has opposite fold-change directions. Agreement is robustness to quantifier choice, not independent validation.
